name: watchdog_regs
desc: Watchdog timer: prescaler, timeout, pre-timeout interrupt, window, keyed kick, lock.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.desc: control (EN and LOCK are ignored once LOCK is set)

fields.name: WINDOW_EN
fields.desc: 1: a kick before WINDOW_OPEN is early (reset)

fields.name: LOCK
fields.desc: 1: EN can no longer be changed (until reset)

registers.name: TIMEOUT
registers.desc: reset after this many ticks without a kick

registers.name: PRETIMEOUT
registers.desc: pre-timeout interrupt after this many ticks (0: off)

registers.name: KICK
registers.desc: write 0x5AFEC0DE to restart the count (other values: bad key)
